note_en: Status of every LiteLLM test. Pass criteria are proposed and fixed before each run. To record a run: change the status and add a line to its history.
note_zh: 每項 LiteLLM 測試的狀態。通過標準先訂再測；每次測試後更新狀態並在 history 加一行。

phase1.crit_en: Mean aggregate TPS gain at least 1.3x
phase1.crit_zh: 平均總吞吐至少 1.3 倍
phase1.needs_en: Not like-for-like: AISO1 ran Q4, PRO6000 ran BF16. It shows gateway scaling, not LiteLLM overhead.
phase1.needs_zh: 不是同條件：AISO1 用 Q4、PRO6000 用 BF16。只證明分流，沒量到閘道額外延遲。

history.en: Two smoke runs, NP 4, 100 output tokens: mean x1.73, passed.
history.zh: 兩次 smoke（NP 4、輸出 100 tokens）：平均 ×1.73，通過。

tests.crit_zh: 失敗請求為 0；30 秒內恢復
tests.needs_en: Mac drill with two fake backends only. After the kill all traffic went to the survivor at once; the restarted backend rejoined in about 5 s. Not tested: a hung backend (the PRO6000 timeout is 600 s) or a cut stream. A drill on the real machine needs the owner's OK.
tests.needs_zh: 僅在 Mac 用兩個假後端驗證。關掉後全部流量立即改走另一台；重啟的後端約 5 秒回到服務。尚未測：後端卡住不回應（PRO6000 逾時設 600 秒）、串流中途被切斷。真機演練要先問 owner。

history.en: Local LiteLLM v1.110.0, 2 fake backends, 4 clients for 70 s, one backend killed at 15 s and restarted at 40 s. 1 retry: 2 failed in each of 3 runs (in flight). 3 retries: 0 failed in 2 runs.
history.zh: 本機 LiteLLM v1.110.0、2 個假後端、4 個用戶端跑 70 秒，第 15 秒關掉一個、第 40 秒重啟。重試 1 次：3 次各有 2 個失敗（在途）。重試 3 次：2 次皆 0 失敗。

tests.result_en: Passes with 3 retries: 0 of about 700 failed (2 runs). Today's setting, 1 retry: 2 of about 700 failed in every run (3 runs), both in flight at the kill; none after.
tests.result_zh: 重試 3 次通過：約 700 個請求 0 個失敗（2 次）。現行設定重試 1 次：每次都有 2 個失敗（3 次），皆是關掉當下在途的請求，之後 0 個。

tests.crit_en: 3 apps, 1 address, own keys; limits do not leak
tests.crit_zh: 3 個應用、1 個網址、各自金鑰；限額互不影響
tests.needs_en: Needs virtual keys, which need a database. The PRO6000 gateway has none yet (db: not connected).
tests.needs_zh: 需要 virtual key，也就需要資料庫；PRO6000 閘道目前沒有（db: not connected）。

tests.crit_zh: 1、2、3 個後端時吞吐隨之成長
tests.needs_en: Needs a third backend (HPE GPU, not arrived).
tests.needs_zh: 需要第三個後端（HPE GPU 尚未到）。

tests.crit_en: Mean aggregate TPS gain at least 1.3x
tests.crit_zh: 平均總吞吐至少 1.3 倍
tests.needs_en: Real machine: PRO6000 GPU1 + GPU7, llama.cpp gemma-4-26B-A4B BF16, 4 slots each, via SSH tunnel from a Mac, 3 repeats, 32 requests per run, 128 tokens. Short replies and one model: treat as a first real measurement, not the final word.
tests.needs_zh: 真機：PRO6000 GPU1＋GPU7，llama.cpp gemma-4-26B-A4B BF16，每張 4 個 slot，從 Mac 經 SSH tunnel 打，重複 3 次，每次 32 個請求、回 128 token。回覆短、只用一個模型：這是第一次真機量測，不是最終結論。

history.en: Tunnel closed; key variable name does not match the config.
history.zh: tunnel 未開；金鑰變數名稱與設定檔不符。

history.en: Pair changed from GPU4+GPU5 (off limits) to GPU6+GPU7. Waiting for the Ray Serve owner to free GPU6. No request sent to any GPU.
history.zh: 成對從 GPU4＋GPU5（不可使用）改為 GPU6＋GPU7。等 Ray Serve 負責人讓出 GPU6。尚未對任何 GPU 送出請求。

history.en: Real run on GPU1 + GPU7 (GPU4/GPU5 off limits, GPU6 held by another PoC). 4 at once: one GPU 264 tokens/s; client round-robin 268 (p95 3329 ms); LiteLLM least-busy 340 (p95 1607 ms) = 1.29x. 8 at once: one GPU 284; round-robin 520; LiteLLM 525 = 1.85x. No failed requests. Mean 1.57x, passes 1.3x. LiteLLM beat round-robin by 27% at 4 at once but only 1% at 8 (both cards full).
history.zh: GPU1＋GPU7 真機測試（GPU4、GPU5 不可使用，GPU6 被另一個 PoC 占用）。同時 4 個：單卡 264 token/s；客戶端輪流 268（p95 3329 ms）；LiteLLM least-busy 340（p95 1607 ms）＝1.29 倍。同時 8 個：單卡 284；輪流 520；LiteLLM 525＝1.85 倍。無失敗請求。平均 1.57 倍，通過 1.3 倍。同時 4 個時 LiteLLM 比輪流多 27%，同時 8 個只多 1%（兩張卡都滿載）。

tests.result_en: Two cards 1.29x at 4 at once, 1.85x at 8. LiteLLM +27% over client round-robin at 4 at once, +1% at 8.
tests.result_zh: 兩張卡：同時 4 個為 1.29 倍，8 個為 1.85 倍。LiteLLM 比客戶端輪流：4 個時多 27%，8 個時多 1%。

tests.crit_zh: 報告 LiteLLM 與無閘道輪流的差距
tests.needs_en: Simulated backends (A 0.2 s, B 0.3 s, each slows 25% per extra request in flight), 16 at once, 3 repeats. The gain comes from load awareness, which an app could build itself; LiteLLM spares every app from doing it. Recheck on real GPUs in B1.
tests.needs_zh: 模擬後端（A 0.2 秒、B 0.3 秒，每多一個在途請求就慢 25%），同時 16 個，重複 3 次。優勢來自「看負載」，應用程式自己也能做；LiteLLM 的價值是讓每個應用不必各做一遍。要在 B1 用真 GPU 再確認。

history.en: Simulated backends, 16 at once, 480 requests, 3 repeats. One backend 16.7 req/s (p95 957 ms); client round-robin 20.7 (p95 1206); LiteLLM least-busy 23.3 (p95 849) = +12% throughput and -30% p95 vs round-robin.
history.zh: 模擬後端，同時 16 個、480 個請求、重複 3 次。單一後端 16.7 req/s（p95 957 ms）；用戶端輪流 20.7（p95 1206）；LiteLLM least-busy 23.3（p95 849），比輪流吞吐 +12%、p95 −30%。

history.en: Relabelled: these numbers come from fake backends on a Mac, not from GPUs. They test the gateway logic only. Real-machine retest is in B1.
history.zh: 改標：這些數字來自 Mac 上的假後端，不是 GPU，只驗證閘道邏輯。真機重測在 B1。

tests.result_en: LiteLLM least-busy: 23.3 req/s, p95 849 ms. Client round-robin: 20.7 req/s, p95 1206 ms. One backend: 16.7 req/s.
tests.result_zh: LiteLLM least-busy：23.3 req/s、p95 849 ms。用戶端輪流：20.7 req/s、p95 1206 ms。單一後端：16.7 req/s。

tests.crit_en: Added latency measured with a fast fake backend
tests.crit_zh: 用快速假後端量出額外延遲
tests.needs_en: Mac only, instant fake backend, 3 repeats. At 8 requests at once the gateway queues (p50 41 ms) because one worker saturates; the PRO6000 gateway is started without --num_workers. Real model replies take seconds, so 5 ms is small; it matters for many short requests.
tests.needs_zh: 僅在 Mac 用「立即回應」的假後端，重複 3 次。同時 8 個請求時閘道會排隊（p50 41 ms），因為單一 worker 飽和；PRO6000 閘道啟動時沒設 --num_workers。真實模型回應要數秒，5 ms 相對很小；請求很短又很多時才看得出來。

history.en: Instant fake backend, direct vs through LiteLLM v1.110.0, 3 repeats. 1 at a time: p50 0.11 -> 5.45 ms (+5.3), p95 +6.9. Streaming: first token +5.7 ms, +0.5 ms per chunk. 8 at once: p50 0.57 -> 40.9 ms; gateway tops out near 187 req/s (direct 12,700).
history.zh: 立即回應的假後端，直連對經 LiteLLM v1.110.0，重複 3 次。一次 1 個：p50 0.11 → 5.45 ms（+5.3）、p95 +6.9。串流：首字 +5.7 ms、每段 +0.5 ms。一次 8 個：p50 0.57 → 40.9 ms；閘道上限約 187 req/s（直連 12,700）。

history.en: Relabelled: these numbers come from fake backends on a Mac, not from GPUs. They test the gateway logic only. Real-machine retest is in B1.
history.zh: 改標：這些數字來自 Mac 上的假後端，不是 GPU，只驗證閘道邏輯。真機重測在 B1。

tests.result_en: Adds about 5 ms per request (p50 +5.3, p95 +6.9), 5.7 ms to the first token and 0.5 ms per streamed chunk. One worker tops out near 190 requests/s.
tests.result_zh: 每個請求約多 5 ms（p50 +5.3、p95 +6.9）；首字多 5.7 ms，串流每段多 0.5 ms。單一 worker 上限約每秒 190 個請求。

tests.needs_en: Fake backends on a Mac (0.20 s base, +25% per extra request in flight), 3 repeats per level, concurrency 1 to 64. Not a GPU measurement; the real curve needs the real pair (B1).
tests.needs_zh: Mac 上的假後端（基礎 0.20 秒，每多一個在途請求慢 25%），每個併發數重複 3 次，併發 1 到 64。不是 GPU 量測；真實曲線要等真機成對（B1）。

history.en: Simulated, concurrency 1/2/4/8/16/32/64: one backend 4.9/7.8/11.2/14.1/16.5/18.2/19.0 req/s; LiteLLM over two 4.4/8.5/14.5/20.6/27.4/32.2/35.5 req/s. Gain 0.9x at 1, 1.46x at 8, 1.87x at 64; p95 at 64: 3357 vs 1779 ms. One failed request at 16.

tests.result_en: Simulated: gain grows with load, 0.9x at 1 request (gateway overhead) to 1.87x at 64.
tests.result_zh: 模擬：負載越高優勢越大，1 個請求時 0.9 倍（閘道開銷），64 個時 1.87 倍。

tests.needs_en: Keep least-busy, which is today's PRO6000 setting. Simulated backends only, same load as B2; recheck on the real GPUs in B1 and B4.
tests.needs_zh: 維持 least-busy，也就是 PRO6000 現行設定。僅模擬後端，負載與 B2 相同；要在 B1、B4 用真 GPU 再確認。

history.en: Same simulated load for all three. least-busy 23.3 req/s (p95 849); simple-shuffle 20.9 (p95 1292); latency-based 16.5 (p95 975), about the same as a single backend (16.7).
history.zh: 三者用同一個模擬負載。least-busy 23.3 req/s（p95 849）；simple-shuffle 20.9（p95 1292）；latency-based 16.5（p95 975），和單一後端（16.7）差不多。

history.en: Relabelled: these numbers come from fake backends on a Mac, not from GPUs. They test the gateway logic only. Real-machine retest is in B1.
history.zh: 改標：這些數字來自 Mac 上的假後端，不是 GPU，只驗證閘道邏輯。真機重測在 B1。

tests.result_en: least-busy wins: 23.3 req/s, p95 849 ms. simple-shuffle: 20.9 req/s, p95 1292 ms (same as round-robin). latency-based: 16.5 req/s, p95 975 ms (no better than one backend).
tests.result_zh: least-busy 最好：23.3 req/s、p95 849 ms。simple-shuffle：20.9 req/s、p95 1292 ms（和輪流相同）。latency-based：16.5 req/s、p95 975 ms（不比單一後端好）。

tests.crit_en: A key stops at its budget; spend logged per key
tests.crit_zh: 金鑰達預算即停；每把金鑰的用量有紀錄
tests.needs_en: Add Postgres. Restarting the shared gateway needs the owner's OK; a Mac PoC avoids that.
tests.needs_zh: 加 Postgres。重啟共用閘道要 owner 同意；Mac PoC 可避開。

tests.crit_en: Requests, latency, errors visible per model
tests.crit_zh: 每個模型的請求數、延遲、錯誤可見
tests.needs_en: /metrics into the existing Prometheus and Grafana on PRO6000; Langfuse or OpenTelemetry for traces.
tests.needs_zh: /metrics 接 PRO6000 現有的 Prometheus 與 Grafana；追蹤用 Langfuse 或 OpenTelemetry。

tests.crit_zh: 停掉一個閘道：失敗請求為 0
tests.needs_en: Two gateway instances plus Redis for shared cooldown and limits. Pin the image version.
tests.needs_zh: 兩個閘道實例加 Redis，共用冷卻與限流；固定 image 版本。

tests.crit_en: Over-limit prompt reroutes with no error
tests.crit_zh: 超長提示自動改道、無錯誤
tests.needs_en: Fallback between the long and balanced groups.
tests.needs_zh: 在 long 與 balanced 兩組之間設 fallback。

tests.crit_en: Same task finishes after only an alias change
tests.crit_zh: 只改別名，同一任務仍能完成
tests.needs_en: Pydantic AI Harness or OpenCode, pointed only at the gateway (harness fixed, model swappable).
tests.needs_zh: Pydantic AI Harness 或 OpenCode 只指向閘道（Harness 固定、模型可換）。

tests.crit_en: Repeat prompt faster; no stale multi-turn answer
tests.crit_zh: 重複提示更快；多輪對話無過期答案
tests.needs_en: Exact-match Redis cache for chat. Skip semantic cache for agent traffic.
tests.needs_zh: 聊天用 Redis 完全比對快取；Agent 流量不用語意快取。

tests.zh: 下層 GPU 感知調度
tests.crit_en: Compare with GPU-aware AP or vLLM Router
tests.crit_zh: 與 GPU-aware AP 或 vLLM Router 比較
tests.needs_en: LiteLLM does keys and quotas; a GPU-aware layer picks the replica.
tests.needs_zh: LiteLLM 管金鑰與配額；GPU 感知層挑副本。
